name: Merfolk
source: Pathfinder NPC Core, Merfolk (pg. 151), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterTemplates.aspx?ID=40
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder NPC Core is ORC licensed material.
rules: Replaces its ancestry trait with merfolk (or adds it); adds amphibious, adds Thalassic, low-light vision, land Speed 5 feet, swim Speed 25 feet.
optional: You can add a supramarine chair item to give the merfolk a land Speed equal to their swim Speed. Use the rules for a wheelchair.
